# Sarah Ateia Khattab, M.S., LPC Associate, NCC, supervised by Don Zablosky, LPC-S

> Holistic, grounding counseling outdoors in Dallas–Fort Worth parks (based in Irving, TX) and by telehealth across Texas, in English and Arabic. Self-pay, $100 per session, with reduced rates available based on household income. Free 15-minute phone consultation.

## Practice details

- Credentials: Licensed Professional Counselor Associate (LPC Associate) #104391, Texas Behavioral Health Executive Council; National Certified Counselor (NCC) #1746909, NBCC
- Supervision: practices under the supervision of Don Zablosky, LPC-S
- Education: M.S., Psychology (Counseling & Human Development), Texas Woman's University; B.S., Psychology, The University of Texas at Dallas
- Welcomes clients of every culture, language, faith or none, gender, sexual orientation, age, body, ability, and background
- Areas served: Irving, Las Colinas, Coppell, Grand Prairie, Carrollton, Farmers Branch, Dallas, Fort Worth, Arlington, Garland, Mesquite, Wilmer (TX), and all of Texas by telehealth
- Formats: in-person sessions held outdoors in a Dallas–Fort Worth park chosen with the client (walking or seated; no office), with a signed outdoor-session consent form and a telehealth fallback for bad weather; telehealth for clients located in Texas at the time of each session
- Languages: English, Arabic
- Fees: self-pay only, no insurance billing; standard fee $100 per session, reduced rates available based on household income; clients may request a Good Faith Estimate
- Areas of focus: anxiety and stress, low mood, emotional overwhelm, nervous system regulation, relationship patterns, burnout, identity and self-understanding, self-esteem, genetics-informed psychoeducation (educational only, not medical advice)
- Contact: (972) 482-9526 · attya.llc@gmail.com
- Business entity: Attya LLC

## Important

- Not a crisis service. In crisis, call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) or go to the nearest emergency room. Dallas–Fort Worth crisis lines: https://www.sarahateia.com/crisis/
- Genetics-related discussion is educational only, not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment; no lab ordering or interpretation.
